name: Uleila del Campo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Uleila del Campo (a bird on blue and a lozengy field on green).
history: Municipal flag of Uleila del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Uleila del Campo arms — bird and lozengy
